coverage: 24 controlled service-integration stories using production AIRI, context assembly, persistent work and DSH. Setup chat and worker decisions use local scripted responses; facts are reviewed through production transactions, day summaries are deterministic source quotes. Final answers and their tool steps use the saved real chat model; final retrieval uses real Voyage. This measures retrieval, injection, answer use and action compliance; it does not re-evaluate automatic fact extraction or replace the normal-product acceptance evidence.
acceptance: All 24 structural scenarios must pass, and each live final answer must receive an evidence-backed semantic review against the frozen oracle. No paid judge, keyword-only pass, repeated sampling or oracle injection. Inconclusive does not pass.

failurePolicy: First transport, storage, admission, structural or semantic failure closes the entire batch. Pause after each live answer for a local review file before advancing. All counters survive story/profile/day changes. No automatic retries or reuse of a closed authorization.
